name: Matangi Rubber Limited
summary: Contract manufacturer of tyre flaps, tubes and 2/3-wheeler tyres (mainly job work for JK Tyre) with five plants in Uttarakhand, Tamil Nadu and Madhya Pradesh; tyre-flap contract manufacturing is 73.4% of FY26 revenue.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹129.76 Cr, EBITDA ₹35.06 Cr (27.0%), PAT ₹22.33 Cr; FY25 PAT ₹20.03 Cr; Q1 FY27 PAT ₹6.42 Cr. D/E 0.85, ROE 20.98%. Trailing P/E ~16.6x at ₹172 (22x on post-issue capital) vs peer composite 23.53.
quota: QIB up to 50% · NII at least 35% (sNII 1/3, bNII 2/3) · Retail at least 15% (RHP Offer Structure); fresh ~₹99 Cr + OFS ~₹26 Cr at upper band
positives: Revenue ~+28% in FY26 with EBITDA margin 27.0% and PAT ₹22.33 Cr
About ₹45 Cr of the fresh issue repays bank loans (D/E already down from 1.54 to 0.85)
Plants sit close to the main customer's facilities; new 2/3-wheeler and tube capacity started
red_flags: Top five customers were 91.6% of FY26 revenue and 98.1% of Q1 FY27, JK Tyre the key customer
EBITDA margin fell from 30.5% (FY25) to 22.4% (Q1 FY27); new 2/3-wheeler plant at ~39% utilisation
~21% of issue is OFS; Jan 2026 pre-IPO round at ~₹95 bonus-adjusted vs ₹172 band; ₹4.19 Cr recovery suit pending
